Welcome back! Today: NVIDIA buying the platform its competitors publish on, a company earning a small nation's annual GDP every day, Apple turning an $899 desktop into an AI server and 116 rivals signing the same warning. In today's Atlas Newsletter: Nvidia agrees to buy Hugging Face for $12.9 billion: The reported $12.9 billion deal hands one chipmaker the neutral ground where Meta, Alibaba and Mistral publish their models. What does $899 run on your desk now? Apple's M6 Mac mini handles 32B models locally, and the M5 Ultra holds 512GB in unified memory. How much does NVIDIA make in a day? Roughly a billion, on $96 billion quarterly revenue and its first-ever full-year forecast. What made 116 rivals agree? OpenAI, Anthropic, Microsoft and Google signed one letter warning the window to strengthen cyber defenses is closing. PS: Want to collaborate with the biggest GTM engine and distribution moat for AI companies? You can feature your tool with us and reach millions. Nvidia agrees to buy Hugging Face for $12.9 billion Hugging Face is popular because it has been a neutral platform used by companies like Meta, Alibaba and Mistral. If NVIDIA buys it, that changes things. The deal is reported at $12.9 billion, which would be one of NVIDIA's largest acquisitions ever.  Against Hugging Face's annualized revenue of around $150 million, the price is buying the position rather than the business. There's history worth knowing.  NVIDIA was already an investor, backing Hugging Face alongside Salesforce and Google in a $235 million round in 2023 that valued it at $4.5 billion.  Last year Hugging Face reportedly rejected a $500 million NVIDIA investment that would have valued it at $7 billion. Two years later the number is nearly double that. The deal would give NVIDIA control of one of the biggest platforms developers use to find, fine-tune and deploy AI models.  It also helps NVIDIA expand beyond chips while Google, Amazon, Microsoft, OpenAI and Anthropic build their own AI hardware.  Anthropic is reportedly in talks with chip startup MatX, and OpenAI shipped its own Broadcom-designed silicon this year. With the reported $1B Poolside deal, NVIDIA has spent nearly $14B this week expanding beyond hardware.  NVIDIA also forecast a 70% revenue jump next fiscal year and says it has $18 billion committed to equity investments through fiscal 2027. 77664.subject: Online check-in for a smooth take-off. ATTENTION! Don’t forget – it opens 24 hours before departure. (Y9SB5U)
77664.body:
Hello, Oleh Novosadov!

Your adventure is just around the corner – you’ll soon be boarding your Ryanair flight! There’s just one small step left to ensure a smooth start: online check-in.

It’s easy – do it via the Ryanair app. This way, you avoid unnecessary fees at the airport..

How to do it? Here’s a quick guide:

You will need:
- Booking code: Y9SB5U
- Booking email: novosadov@boarding.sk (it may differ from your personal email address)

If you’re using the Ryanair mobile app, you can check in directly there – it’s fast, convenient and eco-friendly.

When is check-in available?
- From 24 to 2 hours before departure
- If you’ve purchased seats, you can check in as early as 60 days before your flight

Download your boarding passes.

Save them in the app – you’ll need them when going through airport security. Before your trip, make sure your BOARDING PASSES (tickets) are in ELECTRONIC FORM. Download them to your phone.

You’ll find a full step-by-step guide with screenshots in our manual for checking in online via the Ryanair app.

ATTENTION! If you leave the check-in until the airport, it may cost you up to €55.

That’s a lot of money you could use for your next Pelikan adventure instead! Check our calendar of promotional flights and start planning your next trip right now!

Yours faithfully
